resources.string: Dies ist eine Hörprobe von Simple Narrator. So klingt die ausgewählte Stimme.
This is a sample from Simple Narrator. This is how the selected voice sounds.

One rule per line.
word=pronunciation replaces whole words, upper and lower case do not matter.
*regex=replacement uses a regular expression, $1 inserts the first group.
An empty replacement or [skip] removes the match.
[pause] inserts a pause of 500 ms, [pause:800] one of 800 ms.
Lines starting with # are ignored.
Inside a regular expression, write = as \=.
Reads replacements from Librera Reader and rule files from @Voice Aloud Reader (.txt). Commands without a counterpart here are added as disabled lines.
No rules found in this file.
Line %1$d: the = between pattern and replacement is missing.
Apps such as Readest, Librera or TalkBack can read with the installed voices. To do so, select Simple Narrator as the preferred engine in the system settings under text-to-speech output.
